question: Can payments move cohort A to Deny in the next release without blocking legitimate invoice retries?
intended_control: payments-run-as-non-root: every payments container runs as non-root (mandatory preventive)
authorized_scope: namespace payments, cohort A Deployments only

evidence.locator: disposable cluster run kv-ct-17 (Kyverno v1.20.0, Kubernetes 1.33)
evidence.applies_to: CREATE/UPDATE with real old/new pairs for cohort A objects

evidence.locator: PolicyReports payments cohort A, 14-day canary window

lead.provisional_conclusion: Cohort A can move to Deny: parity holds on CREATE and UPDATE and legitimate retries pass.
lead.easiest_way_wrong: A legitimate invoice retry path not represented in the controlled test (e.g. a debug sidecar) runs as root.

referrals.return_question: What is the p99 admission latency for pod CREATE in payments during the canary window?
referrals.answer: p99 within the release envelope for the window supplied; baseline before the canary unknown.

challenge.counterexample: invoice-retry-worker restarted with an injected debug container that runs as root

claims.statement: All 42 cohort A objects report pass in the canary window.
Deny would not have rejected any cohort A write observed in the window.
claims.rule: pass under Audit implies admission under Deny for the same inputs

claims.statement: No debug containers are injected into cohort A in production.

tests.expected: invoice-batch-root denied with the policy message
invoice-api image bump with old/new pair admitted

business_exposure: Wrongly denied invoice retries delay revenue collection for cohort A.
suggested_action: Promote cohort A to validationActions [Deny] in the next release via the live admission guard; keep other cohorts in Audit.
rollback_limits: Reverting to Audit restores admission behavior for future writes only; writes denied during the window are not replayed.
limitations: Controlled-test equivalence to production is argued, not proven.
Baseline latency before the canary is unknown.

audit_assessment.promotion_criteria: zero fail results and parity on CREATE/UPDATE for 14 days
audit_assessment.reasoning: Approved, time-bounded canary inside its window with an owner and promotion criteria; Audit is intended here.
